seoTitle: Social Image Size Checker for Open Graph Images
metaDescription: Choose an image to check pixels, aspect ratio and file size against Facebook and LinkedIn link-preview guidance. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Reads an image locally and tests it against published sharing guidance.
why:
A wrong-sized og:image gets cropped, shown small or ignored. The rules differ between platforms and change over time.

This tool checks Facebook (200x200 minimum, 600x315 for a large preview, 1200x630 recommended, 8 MB) and LinkedIn (1200x627, 1.91:1, 5 MB). X and Slack are not tested because their limits could not be verified at the source. A pass is not a guarantee.
howTo: Read its pixels, ratio and size.
See each check as PASS, REVIEW or FAIL.
Resize if needed and check again.

faq.a: Both platforms recommend about that ratio for link previews.
No, it is read in your browser.
Its limits could not be checked at the source.
Whatever your browser can decode, such as PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF.
